title: Delete Team
description: Deletes a team

title: Remove from Team
description: Removes an entity from a team

title: Team of Entity
description: Gets the team of an entity

title: Ban List
description: Provides a list of all the banned players

title: Team Color
description: Gets the color of a Team

title: Idle Timeout
description: Gets or sets the idle timeout (minutes) for the server.

title: Animal Spawn Ticks
description: Gets the animal spawn rate, in ticks, of the server.

title: Water Spawn Ticks
description: Gets the water spawn rate, in ticks, of the server.

title: Water Animal Spawn Limit
description: Gets the limit of water animal spawns.

title: Team Name
description: Gets the name of a team

title: Team Prefix
description: Gets the prefix of a team

title: Server Name
description: Gets the server implementation name of Bukkit.

title: Beacon Tier
description: Gets the tier level of the beacon depending on how many layers it has

title: Has Stung
description: Checks if the entity has stung before if the entity is a Bee

title: Add to Team
description: Adds an entity to a team

title: Team Suffix
description: Gets the suffix of a team

title: Flower Location (Beehive)
description: Gets the flower location of a block if it is a Beehive

title: Anger Level
description: Gets the anger level of an entity if the entity is a Bee.

title: Hive Location
description: Gets the location of an entity's hive if they are a Bee

title: Is Sedated
description: Checks whether or not a block is sedated via smoke if the block is a Beehive

title: Primary Effect
description: Gets the primary effect of a block if the block is a Beacon

title: Secondary Effect
description: Gets the secondary potion effect of a block if the block is a Beacon

title: Puffstate
description:
Gets the value of the puffstate of an entity if the entity is a Pufferfish
[0-2, 0 being deflated, 2 being inflated]

title: Pattern Color
description: Gets the color of the pattern of an entity if that entity is a Tropical Fish

title: Body Color
description: Gets the body color of an entity if the entity is a Tropical Fish

title: Is Converting
description: Checks if an entity is converting into a drowned if the entity is a Zombie

title: Executor (Command Block)
description: Gets the executor (or name) that is used to run commands in a block if the block is a Command Block

title: Flower Location (Bee)
description: Gets the location of an entity's flower if they are a Bee

title: Command (Command Block)
description: Gets the command from a block if the block is a Command Block

title: Cannot Enter Ticks
description: Gets the number of ticks that an entity has to wait before returning to their Beehive if the entity is a Bee
syntax_pattern:
[the] cannot enter ticks of %livingentities% 
%livingentities%'[s] cannot enter ticks

title: Box Color
description:
Gets the color of a Shulker Box Block

<Added this because "color of block" where the block was a shulker box was not working for me, if that works for you in vanilla, great. If not, you can use this>

title: Is Shivering
description: Checks whether or not an entity is shivering, meaning they are a Strider and are not in a "warm" environment

title: Entities in Range
description: Gets the entities that are in range, meaning they acquire the effects of a Beacon. These values are only Players as only players are affected by a Beacon.
syntax_pattern:
entit(ys|ies) in range of %blocks%
%blocks%'[s] entit(ys|ies) in range

title: Is Awake
description: Checks whether an entity is awake, that entity is a Bat.

title: Stung State
description: Gets the Has Stung value of a Bee, this will return a boolean (yes/no) dependant on if they have or have not stung before. Refer to the Has Stung syntax

title: Create Team
description: Makes a new team

title: Team
description: Represents a team, these are the same as the vanilla teams system.

title: Spawn Radius
description: Gets or sets the spawn radius, in blocks, of the server.

title: Monster Spawn Ticks
description: Gets the monster spawn rate, in ticks, of the server.

title: Is Pollinated
description: Checks if an entity has nectar/pollen if the entity is a Bee

title: Fluid Level Change
description: Called when the fluid level of a block changes due to changes in adjacent blocks.

title: Bat Toggle Sleep
description:
Called when a bat attempts to sleep or wake up from its slumber.
If a Bat Toggle Sleep event is cancelled, the Bat will not toggle its sleep state.

title: Lectern Take
description: This event is called when a player clicks the button to take a book of a Lectern. If this event is cancelled the book remains on the lectern.

title: Moisture Change
description: Called when the moisture level of a soil block changes.

title: Snowman Derp
description: Checks whether this snowman is in "derp mode", meaning it is not wearing a pumpkin.

title: Endermite Player Spawned
description: Checks whether this Endermite was spawned by a player.

title: Trade Select
description: This event is called whenever a player clicks a new trade on the trades sidebar.

title: Enderman Carried Block
description: Gets the data of the block that the Enderman is carrying.

title: Player Spawned
description:
Gets whether this Endermite was spawned by a player.
(See condition)

title: Snowman Derp State
description:
Gets whether this snowman is in "derp mode", meaning it is not wearing a pumpkin.
(See condition)

title: Pollen State
description: Gets a boolean (yes/no true/false) of the entity's nectar / pollen <refer to the pollination condition> if the entity is a Bee

title: Object Type
description: Gets the type of an object, an object being a variable or something else. If the variable/object is a String, it will return "String", and so on.

title: Player Created
description: Checks wether an Iron Golem is player created (as in they built it)

title: Friendly Fire State of Team
description: Checks if a team allows friendly fire

title: Friendly Invisibles
description: Checks if a team member can see friendly invisibles

title: Player Created Value
description:
Gets the value of player created condition of an Iron Golem
(See condition)

title: Team Display Name
description: Gets the display name of a Team

title: Team Entries
description: Gets a list of entries of a team, the list is a list of Strings because they are based on entity name.

title: Team Size
description: Gets the size of a team, which is how many entries a team has.

title: Not Boolean
description: This expression returns the opposite value of a boolean, useful for toggling true/false values.

title: Ambient Spawn Ticks
description: Gets the ambient spawn rate, in ticks, of the server.

title: Is Force Loaded
description: Checks whether or not a chunk is force loaded

title: Inside Border
description: Checks if a location is outside of the world border

title: Entities in Chunk
description: Provides a list of entities located in the provided chunk

title: Force Loaded State
description: Provides the value of the Is Force Loaded condition, can be set to a boolean (yes/no).

title: Shutdown Message
description: Gets the shutdown message, message sent when the server stops, of the server.

title: Water Ambient Spawn Ticks
description: Gets the water ambient spawn rate, in ticks, of the server.

title: Water Ambient Spawn Limit
description: Gets the limit of water ambient spawns.

title: Wolf Collar Color
description: Gets or sets the collar color of an entity, if that entity is a wolf

title: Fox Crouch State
description:
Gets the state of an entity's crouching, if that entity is a wolf.
Can be set, but note that the entity will override it setting it back to standing.

title: Sleep State
description:
Gets the sleep state of an entity
Can be set if the entity is a fox, but note that the entity will override this causing it to go back to standing.

title: Restock Amount
description: Gets the amount of times a villager has restocked during that day

title: Player Leash
description:
Called just prior to when a player leashes an entity
`event-player` is the player who leashed
`event-entity` is the entity being leashed

title: Whitelist Toggle
description:
Called when the whitelist is toggled on or off
[ `/whitelist on` or `/whitelist off` ]
`event-boolean` is the value of if the whitelist is now on or off

title: Villager Sleep
description: Attempts  to make a villager sleep at a certain location. The location has to be a bed or else nothing will happen.

title: Open Lid
description: Plays the open animation for the container block [chest, barrel, shulker box] without there being a player to receive the inventory. The chest will stay in the open position until it is closed using the `Close Lid` effect.

title: Close Lid
description: Plays the closing animation for a container block [chest, barrel, shulker box] without there being a player to receive the inventory.

title: Allow
description: Allows a connection from the `on connect` event, this means that the player attempting to join will be able to join the server. This will mean that they can bypass the whitelist and any other connections that end with them being disconnected.

title: Disallow
description: This is the opposite of the `Allow` effect. This will kick the player attempting to join, and give them a message.

title: Is Sleeping
description: Checks if an entity is sleeping, this applies to all living entities, although not all entities can sleep.

title: Fox Is Crouching
description: Checks if a fox is in the crouching position, as in they are sitting down.
